messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: JSS publication and new release
parts:
Hi all,

After quite a long time, I'm very glad to announce that our paper
"simmer: Discrete-Event Simulation for R" finally appeared in the
Journal of Statistical Software:
http://dx.doi.org/10.18637/jss.v090.i02. Please, use this reference
for citations.

There's also a new version (v4.3.0) on CRAN. Special thanks to Tom
Lawton for his valuable input for this release. Here's a comprehensive
list of changes: https://r-simmer.org/news/index.html#simmer-4-3-0

Regards,
--
Iñaki Úcar

Congratulations - I was about to message you as we're heading toward
the writeup stage and wanted some way to note your input to our
project! Many thanks for everything you've done.

tom
